title: GitHub Actions Reusable Workflow Examples
title_es: Ejemplos de Workflows Reutilizables de GitHub Actions
description: Runnable reusable GitHub Actions workflows and their callers: workflow_call with typed inputs, secrets mapping and inherit, JSON matrix with fromJSON, conditional jobs, outputs, nesting, and a Docker build variant.
description_es: Workflows reutilizables de GitHub Actions listos para usar junto a sus callers: workflow_call con inputs tipados, mapeo de secrets e inherit, matrix JSON con fromJSON, jobs condicionales, outputs, anidamiento y una variante de build de Docker.
